crossRefs.note: That your way may be known on earth, and your salvation among all nations,
Shout for joy to Yahweh, all you lands!
Praise Yahweh, all you nations! Extol him, all you peoples!
For his loving kindness is great toward us. Yahweh’s faithfulness endures forever. Praise Yah!
Rejoice, you nations, with his people, for he will avenge the blood of his servants. He will take vengeance on his…
Again he says, “Rejoice, you Gentiles, with his people.”
Again, “Praise the Lord, all you Gentiles! Let all the peoples praise him.”
Who wouldn’t fear you, Lord, and glorify your name? For you only are holy. For all the nations will come and worship…

translations.web: Sing to God, you kingdoms of the earth! Sing praises to the Lord!
translations.bsb: Sing to God, O kingdoms of the earth; sing praises to the Lord— Selah
translations.kjv: Sing unto God, ye kingdoms of the earth; O sing praises unto the Lord; Selah:
translations.asv: Sing unto God, ye kingdoms of the earth; Oh sing praises unto the Lord; Selah
